window: H1 cached bars 2023-12 to 2026-10; parameters chosen on the first half, every reported figure read on the unseen second half
accounting: R per trade, net of spread, stop sized at 1.5 x ATR(14)
method: Each agent proposes a hypothesis, sweeps its own parameters on the FIRST half of the bars only, and is then read once on the unseen second half. A margin over the champion counts as a win only if it clears two standard errors.

agents.name: Squeeze Release
agents.hypothesis: Volatility contraction precedes expansion, so the break of a quiet range carries further than a break of a noisy one.
agents.verdict: Did not beat the champion: -0.118 R/trade at PF 0.88 over 100 trades on the unseen half.

agents.name: Session Open Drive
agents.hypothesis: The first hours after a session open set the day's intent; the break of the opening range follows that intent.
agents.verdict: Scored above the champion (0.504 vs 0.278 R/trade) but the margin is only 0.5 standard errors over 83 trades, so this data cannot tell it from chance.

agents.name: Stretch Fade
agents.hypothesis: The trend system's own signs mark continuation; this agent tests the inverse directly by fading an RSI-hot, ATR-stretched extreme.
agents.verdict: Did not beat the champion: -0.500 R/trade at PF 0.48 over 118 trades on the unseen half.

agents.name: Momentum Persistence
agents.hypothesis: A move already large relative to volatility tends to continue rather than revert.
agents.verdict: Scored above the champion (0.475 vs 0.278 R/trade) but the margin is only 0.5 standard errors over 89 trades, so this data cannot tell it from chance.

agents.name: Inside-Bar Release
agents.hypothesis: An inside bar is a one-bar balance; the side that breaks it inherits the imbalance.
agents.verdict: Did not beat the champion: -0.314 R/trade at PF 0.69 over 96 trades on the unseen half.

agents.name: Trend Pullback
agents.hypothesis: Entering a trend on a retrace pays better than entering on the breakout that made the high.
agents.verdict: Did not beat the champion: -0.245 R/trade at PF 0.75 over 119 trades on the unseen half.

agents.name: Week Open Edge
agents.hypothesis: The first hours of the trading week carry positioning flow that persists into the week.
agents.verdict: Did not beat the champion: -0.759 R/trade at PF 0.27 over 78 trades on the unseen half.

agents.name: Range Expansion
agents.hypothesis: A bar far larger than its neighbours is information, and its close direction has follow-on.
agents.verdict: Did not beat the champion: 0.004 R/trade at PF 1.00 over 34 trades on the unseen half.
